title: Tamed Euler Schemes for Singular SDEs with Multiplicative Levy Noise
summary: We prove strong convergence rates for tamed Euler schemes of multidimensional stochastic differential equations with singular drift, multiplicative Brownian noise, and multiplicative Levy noise. The drift is assumed to satisfy a Ladyzhenskaya-Prodi-Serrin type condition, while the diffusion and jump coefficients have Sobolev-type spatial regularity. The proof is based on a nonlocal Zvonkin transform, Krylov-type estimates, and a stochastic Gronwall argument.
